outcome: Incidence of numbness in the lower extremities
Incidence of motor weakness in the lower extremities
cohort: 205 patients who underwent cesarean section with combined spinal-epidural anesthesia at the University of Tsukuba Hospital between April 2018 and March 2020
finding: A more caudal epidural catheter placement during cesarean section was associated with increased incidence of numbness and motor weakness in the lower extremities, but not with analgesic effect.
mod_finding: Epidural catheter placement at the T10-11 or T11-12 interspace may reduce the effect on the lower extremities and improve the quality of postoperative analgesia after a cesarean section.
